review_candidates.title: Business Process Analyst
review_candidates.description: Business Process Analyst Purpose of the Job The Business Process Analyst (BPA) discovers, documents, and improves Coptic Orphans’ business processes to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and alignment with organizational objectives. The role owns the full analysis cycle for its assigned process portfolio: mapping the As-Is process, validating that map with the process owners, confirming pain points and their root causes, appraising improvement options, and preparing the resulting improvement recommendations for approval. Essential Functions and Responsibilities Business Process Analysis and Modelling: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and conduct structured process discovery through stakeholder interviews, facilitated workshops, job shadowing, and document and system trace analysis, accurately documenting how processes operate in practice. Document and model identified process flows in SAP Signavio using BPMN 2.0 and the department’s agreed modelling conventions, naming standards, and level-of-detail rules. Collect and analyze process data, including volumes, cycle and waiting times, handoffs, rework, and exception rates, using appropriate statistical methods and analytical tools to identify trends, assess process performance, and support evidence-based decision-making. Maintain SAP Signavio repository integrity, including version control, model metadata and attributes, glossary and dictionary entries, and archiving of superseded models . Stakeholder Validation and Sign-Off: With the support and supervision of the Business Process Manager, validate the documented As-Is process with process owners and key participants to confirm that it reflects actual practice, resolve discrepancies, and obtain and record formal process-owner sign-off. Identify and confirm Initial process inefficiencies, bottlenecks, control gaps, and other improvement opportunities with the Business Process Manager and relevant stakeholders, including root causes where appropriate. Maintain appropriate records of stakeholder validation, decisions, and agreed actions, and escalate unresolved issues or decisions requiring management or cross-departmental input. Solution Design and Improvement Planning: Develop the To-Be process and model it in SAP Signavio, showing the delta against the validated As-Is model, for review and presentation to the Business Process Manager. Develop initial improvement plans and supporting business cases outlining objectives, scope, expected benefits, resources, risks, and implementation considerations, and present recommendations to the Business Process Manager and relevant process owners for approval, as required. Support the implementation of approved process improvements by providing process expertise and addressing process-related issues. Process Performance Management and Reporting Define and monitor process KPIs, establish a performance baseline for each process using data from the existing (As-Is) process, and analyze process performance to identify issues, trends and improvement opportunities, recommending appropriate actions. Develop and maintain process performance dashboards, monitor performance against the baseline established during As-Is analysis, assess the impact of process changes, and report findings to the Process Manager on the agreed cycle . Perform other duties commensurate with the role and level, as requested by the Process Manager. Required Education, Experience, Knowledge, and Skills Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. 1–3 years of experience in business process analysis, process performance analysis, or a related field. Proven experience with working knowledge of Business Process Management (BPM) methodologies and of the process lifecycle (discovery, modelling, analysis, improvement, monitoring). Practical ability to model in BPMN 2.0. Hands-on experience with SAP Signavio is required; experience with another enterprise BPM suite (ARIS, Bizagi, Camunda) may be accepted where the candidate can demonstrate BPMN modelling competence. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to analyze processes and relevant data. Strong communication, interviewing, facilitation, active-listening, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels, gather information effectively, and communicate findings clearly through effective reporting. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with familiarity with tools used for process visualization and performance reporting. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills. Proven experience with Lean and Six Sigma techniques, and (Green Belt or higher) is a plus. Familiarity with process automation tools is an advantage (robotic process automation, workflow automation, SAP Signavio Process Automation). Travel and Working Requirements Limited to typical office environment such as walking, sitting, typing, using office equipment, and occasional lifting of boxes or luggage during travel. Occasional travel, nationally or internationally, is expected. Working out of the official hours and on weekends may be required.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: About Us Glomo builds fast, secure, and borderless payment products. Our real-time cross-border network connects local payment rails across countries, so customers move money across borders in seconds. Glomo holds full authorisation as a Payment Service Provider, the first of its kind in India, and is regulated by IFSCA. Payment veterans with more than 100 years of combined experience in large payment products built and back Glomo. Your Impact As an Infrastructure Engineer at Glomo, you own the platform that every payment runs on. You design, build, and operate our systems on GCP and Kubernetes, and keep them available, secure, and compliant. Our infrastructure moves real money for real customers every day. A failed deploy or a slow database is a failed payment. You make sure that the platform scales with our volume, recovers fast from failure, and passes regulatory and PCI-DSS audits. What You Will Do Run our cloud platform - design, build, and operate our GCP environments (production and sandbox) as infrastructure as code. Own Kubernetes - operate our GKE clusters, deploy pipelines, autoscale, and rollout strategy for the Rails monolith, Sidekiq workers, and supporting services. Keep data safe and fast - operate PostgreSQL (AlloyDB) and Redis: replication, read replicas, backups, point-in-time recovery, upgrades, and query and connection tuning. Make failure boring - build and test disaster recovery and failover. Define SLOs, alerts, and runbooks, and lead the response when an incident occurs. Give engineers visibility - own metrics, logs, and traces so that each team finds the cause of a problem in minutes. Ship fast and safe - improve CI/CD so that engineers deploy many times a day with zero downtime. Secure the platform - own network design, IAM, secrets management, and access control. Keep the platform compliant with PCI-DSS and regulator audits. Control cost - measure and reduce cloud spend without loss of reliability. What You Will Bring Production infrastructure experience - 2-6 years of operation of production systems with real traffic, preferably in payments or fintech. Strong GCP skills - hands-on experience with GKE, VPC networks, IAM, Cloud SQL or AlloyDB, and Cloud Load Balancing. Deep AWS experience also counts. Kubernetes depth - run clusters in production and know Helm, autoscalers, resource limits, and safe rollouts. Database operations - operate PostgreSQL at scale: replication, failover, backups, vacuum, and index and query tuning. Infrastructure as code - build and maintain infrastructure with Terraform or an equivalent tool, and you review it like application code. Scripting and automation - write clean, tested scripts and tools in Bash, Python, Go, or Ruby. CI/CD expertise - build pipelines for trunk-based development with frequent, safe deploys. Security awareness - protect financial data and customer PII by default: least-privilege access, encryption, and secrets management. Ownership mentality - own systems from design to on-call, and you fix the root cause, not only the symptom. Cross-functional collaboration - work closely with product engineers, security, and compliance to deliver changes. Good to have experience with PCI-DSS, SOC 2, or audits from a financial regulator Observability stacks such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, or Grafana Redis and Terraform Zero-trust access tools such as Teleport Rails and Sidekiq in production Disaster recovery drills and chaos tests Perks & Benefits Ground-floor opportunity at a fast-growing company, where your work directly sets our direction Accelerated career growth: we invest in your development Competitive compensation with equity ownership Comprehensive health insurance, flexible time off, and a professional development budget A close team that celebrates wins and supports each other
